يحتقبون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَقِبُونَ (yaḥtaqibūna) /jaħ.ta.qi.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# يُحْتَقَبُونَ (yuḥtaqabūna) /juħ.ta.qa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
